name: MIT-BIH Normal Sinus Rhythm Database
description: The MIT-BIH Normal Sinus Rhythm Database is a widely utilized normative reference dataset compiled by the Beth Israel Hospital Arrhythmia Laboratory in Boston. It includes 18 long-term two-channel ambulatory Holter ECG recordings (each approximately 24 hours long, sampled at 128 Hz) acquired from healthy adult subjects (5 men, aged 26 to 45; and 13 women, aged 20 to 50) who underwent continuous Holter monitoring and were verified to have no significant arrhythmias. Users should note that this repository contains continuous raw ECG waveforms, serving as a clean baseline for cardiac pathology comparisons, distinct from the RR interval-only NSR dataset.
